attributes.action: Later start to secondary school days
attributes.additional_details: A later start will vastly improve students' attitude to school and reduce sleep deprivation. Allowing teenagers enough sleep fosters a positive, motivated attitude towards learning. Which will create a happier, more productive classroom enviroment
attributes.background: The current system forces teenagers to wake up at times that disrupt their natural biological sleep patterns. Morning rush hour means some students arrive to school later and a 10:00 am start resolves both issues, supporting student well-being and ensuring more people arrive on time.

rejection.details:
